# Section 12: Student Support Services

Section 12 addresses support services that contribute to student success.

## Standard 12.1 — Student Support Services [CR] {.core-requirement}

::: {.callout-important}
## Core Requirement
:::

### What SACSCOC is Trying to Ensure

The institution provides appropriate support services for its student population.

### Typical Evidence Types

- Catalog of student services
- Descriptions of each service area
- Usage data
- Student satisfaction data
- Staffing for services

### Suggested Owners

- Vice President for Student Services
- Student Services Directors

### Common Pitfalls / Weak Evidence

- Services don't match student population needs
- Limited access for distance/online students
- Insufficient staffing
- No evidence of service effectiveness

::: {.callout-note title="NC Considerations"}
NC community colleges serve diverse student populations including:

- Recent high school graduates
- Career changers and adult learners
- High school students (Career & College Promise)
- Basic skills and GED students

Document services addressing each population's unique needs.
:::

---

## Standard 12.2 — Student Rights

### What SACSCOC is Trying to Ensure

The institution has policies that protect student rights and are disseminated to students.

### Typical Evidence Types

- Student rights policies
- Grievance procedures
- Student handbook
- Publication evidence

---

## Standard 12.3 — Student Records

### What SACSCOC is Trying to Ensure

The institution maintains secure and confidential student records.

### Typical Evidence Types

- FERPA compliance documentation
- Records security procedures
- Records retention policy
- Access controls

---

## Standard 12.4 — Academic Advising

### What SACSCOC is Trying to Ensure

The institution provides academic advising to support student success.

### Typical Evidence Types

- Advising model description
- Advisor qualifications
- Advising load data
- Student satisfaction with advising

### Common Pitfalls / Weak Evidence

- High advisor-to-student ratios
- Unclear advising responsibilities
- No advisor training program

---

## Standard 12.5 — Financial Aid Office

### What SACSCOC is Trying to Ensure

The institution provides financial aid services with adequate staffing and oversight.

### Typical Evidence Types

- Financial aid policies and procedures
- Staff qualifications
- Aid disbursement data
- Compliance audits

::: {.callout-note title="NC Considerations"}
NC community college students may access:

- Federal financial aid (Pell, loans)
- NC-specific aid (NC Need-Based Scholarships, NC Education Lottery)
- Local scholarships and foundation support

Document all financial aid programs and eligibility requirements.
:::

---

## Standard 12.6 — Co-Curricular Activities (if applicable)

### What SACSCOC is Trying to Ensure

If the institution offers co-curricular activities, they are appropriate for the mission and student population.

### Typical Evidence Types

- List of student organizations
- Co-curricular programming
- Student leadership opportunities

---

## Reflective Prompts

- How do we assess the effectiveness of student services?
- What evidence shows services meet diverse student needs?
- How are online/distance students supported?
